header.title: Curse tablets from Latium et Campania, in Greek (Regio I), in Greek (Epigraphic Database Heidelberg): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek curse tablets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:defix:edh:latium-et-campania-regio-i-grc:grc, from the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.

notes.53119.1: Lines 1-2, 6-8 and 16 are magical names and letter strings, kept transliterated; line 2 may hide Greek words but cannot be divided with confidence, and line 16 is unclear ('pherro' could be Latin ferro in Greek letters). [[ ]] marks erased letters. Codratilla is the Greek spelling of Latin Quadratilla. Line 17: 'μέλ[λ]ει' ('is about to') sits awkwardly before the imperative 'διακόπτ[ε]' ('cut off'), so the syntax of lines 15-17 is uncertain. The text breaks off mid-sentence.
